photos.title: Jump
photos.description:
Budaklı thermal spring, which is located in Budaklı village, 7 kilometers from Güroymak district of Bitlis, welcomes local and foreign tourists seeking healing, especially in the summer, with its water at 40 degrees, it becomes a haunt of buffaloes and horses in winter.

In the village where the winter is harsh, the animals that are contaminated are not taken out of the stables, and they are taken to the spa at certain intervals to be cleaned by their owners.

In the village, where the air temperature drops below 20 degrees below zero, the breeders who float their animals in the spa under the cover of the snow enjoy swimming in warm and healing water.

photos.title: Atomic Bomb
photos.description:
Надеюсь заряд всех атомных бомб никогда не приведется в действие и сверху на нас будет падать не радиоактивный пепел, а чистая, прохладная вода. 

I hope the charge of all atomic bombs will never be triggered and pure, cool water will fall on top of us, not radioactive ash.
